headline: MicroStrategy CFO Resigns Amid Record Profit; MSTR Shares Fall 6%
summary: MicroStrategy reported $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC. Shares fell 6% following the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Andrew Kang.
why: MicroStrategy is an enterprise software company widely watched by investors as a major corporate treasury holder of bitcoin.

impacts.why: MicroStrategy shares fell 6% after CFO Andrew Kang announced his resignation alongside quarterly results.
